description: Manifest for one versioned dataset release. Records source hashes, license references, collection dates, filtering decisions, and the resulting record counts so any training run is reproducible from the manifest alone.

excluded_competitions.description: Competition IDs deliberately excluded from this dataset version, e.g. held-out benchmark competitions.

notes.description: Free-form notes on this dataset version.

record_counts.description: Number of trajectory records per category.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the assembled dataset file (JSONL) this manifest describes.

filtering_decisions.description: What was kept, dropped, or transformed from this source and why.

license.description: License under which the source may be used for training.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source file as collected.

source_url.description: Public URL of the source material.

title: Akarui dataset manifest
